purpose: The grading record of the software-craft skill: the fixture dry run of the review path in both pre-pass modes, the smoke task of the developer path, the pinned models, and the constraints the measurement satisfied and did not.

review.source: TIERS in scripts/craft-review-workflow.js; a Fable model is refused there

fixture.tree: evals/fixture/base and evals/fixture/head: 34 files in the head tree over errors/ (Python, Go, TypeScript), tests/ (Java, Python, TypeScript) and code/ (Java, Go, Rust)
fixture.expected: evals/expected.json: 36 seeds (one per pilot card) and 36 controls (one per pilot card)

worktree_mode.compared_to_committed: the job set is identical on rule id, slice name, file paths, added lines, matched patterns, signals and hunk indices; the order of files inside a slice differs; the inventory's file set is identical
worktree_mode.finders_and_skeptics: not re-run in this mode: the plan is the only input of the Find stage that the mode changes, so the grading of this mode rests on the plan comparison

smoke_task.task: a token-bucket rate limiter in errors/py/ratelimit.py with tests in errors/py/test_ratelimit.py, on a copy of the fixture tree in committed mode, the change left uncommitted
smoke_task.dispatch: one general-purpose agent carrying the body of agents/software-developer.md as its prompt, claude-opus-5-5 at max; the plugin agent type does not resolve in a checkout

developer.tests: 20 passed (pytest, re-run by the operator after the review)
developer.checks: ruff, mypy --strict on the module, pyright on the module, per the agent's report

smoke_task.integrity: after the developer run and again after the review run, git status in the smoke tree showed the two new files and the review's craft/ directory only; no tracked file changed

findings.what: a NaN clock reading passes the backwards-clock guard; the skeptic narrowed the stated consequence and extended the fix to the constructor reading
the public parameter n names a domain value; the developer's report had left it in place under CODE-03's conventional-letter exception and the task's interface

smoke_task.reading: a single-run, unrepeated measurement: the developer path builds, its tests pass, the review finds nothing major and one real defect the developer's own self-review missed

satisfied: every seed found and every control silent in committed mode (72/72)
the worktree pre-pass plans the same jobs as the committed pre-pass
the smoke task builds, its tests pass, its review report is written
no review or research stage runs on a Fable model
the finders and skeptics edited nothing: the tree was unchanged after every run
every pinned model is a model id, not an alias
unsatisfied: agent types: the plugin types code-quality:craft-finder, code-quality:craft-verifier and code-quality:software-developer do not resolve in this checkout, so every workflow agent ran as the runtime's default sub-agent with the same prompt and the same tiers, and the developer ran as a general-purpose agent carrying the definition's body
worktree mode is graded at the pre-pass plan, not by a second finder and skeptic run
the skeptics rejected nothing on the fixture: its seeds are clear-cut, so the run does not measure severity calibration or the rejection path

the sub-agents' WebSearch budget (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION, 200 per session) was spent before the pilot's source layer ran; cards reached papers through GitHub-hosted copies and the orchestrator's relayed snippets
the smoke task ran once; the developer's token figure is the harness's total for the agent, which does not separate cache reads
the per-card audit ran on one card per domain, not on all 36
